title: JobSummary
description: Aggregated job statistics with totals and time-bucketed histogram for scheduled jobs only.

totals.description: Aggregated total counts of scheduled jobs by status.

buckets.description:
Time-series histogram of scheduled job outcomes. Each bucket represents a
time interval
with counts of succeeded and failed scheduled jobs. The bucket interval is
automatically
determined based on the query time range (5 minutes to 30 days).

JobSummaryBucket.description: A single time bucket in the scheduled job history histogram.

timestamp.description:
The start time of this bucket (RFC3339). Scheduled jobs with start_time in
the interval
[timestamp, timestamp+interval) are counted in this bucket.

failed.description: Number of scheduled jobs in this bucket that failed.

succeeded.description: Number of scheduled jobs in this bucket that succeeded.

skipped.description:
Number of scheduled jobs in this bucket that were skipped. Note: skipped
jobs are tracked from Connect version 2026.03.0 onward.

JobSummaryTotals.description: Total counts of scheduled jobs by status.

waiting.description:
Number of scheduled jobs queued but not yet started. For time ranges in the
past, this will be 0.

running.description:
Number of currently executing scheduled jobs. For time ranges in the past,
this will be 0.

succeeded.description: Number of scheduled jobs that completed successfully (exit code 0).

failed.description: Number of scheduled jobs that failed (non-zero exit code).

skipped.description:
Number of scheduled jobs that were skipped. Note: skipped jobs are tracked
from Connect version 2026.03.0 onward.
